sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-dependent blueprint, per-template placement counts, recolor legend, and uniquely modal template color.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Overlay the separated blueprint panels by coordinate, identify each placement color, and count how often every template is requested.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Expand only placements selected by the episode scope into the corresponding template masks and recolor them from the legend.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Under modal_template, the renderer cannot know which spatial blocks survive until the separated placement panels are overlaid and their template-color counts are compared.

parametric_work.summary: Native all|modal_template family with 2–6 demonstrations, four private queries, protected Racket labels, finite-rival audit, public projection, authoring preflight, and source-bound causal replay.

target.summary: Built the general template-blueprint expansion rule and a modal-template parametric branch; repaired a four-template sampler defect found by broad preflight.
